title: Dime Foundation Development-Evaluation Remote Identity
description: Binds the complete cases/**/*.jsonl inventory and evaluation manifest to one exact private Hugging Face dataset commit. Remote privacy, inventory equality, byte equality, explicit authentication, and no-fallback behavior are enforced by the verifier.

revision.description: Exact lowercase 40-character Hugging Face commit SHA; branches and tags are prohibited.

case_files.description: Strictly path-sorted, exhaustive inventory of every remote path below cases/ whose name ends in .jsonl.

case_files_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 canonical JSON serialization of the complete ordered case_files array, including its trailing newline.

case_count.description: Sum of record_count across every declared case file.

path.description: POSIX-relative remote repository path below cases/; traversal, absolute paths, symlinks, and non-JSONL paths are rejected by the verifier.
